items.title: J&J looks to buy Ollin Biosciences for up to $3.4 billion, FT says
items.summary: Nov 15 () - Johnson & Johnson could announce a deal as soon as Monday ‌to buy Texas-based biotech Ollin Biosciences ‌for up to $3.4 billion, the Financial Times said, citing ​people familiar with the matter.

items.title: J&J in talks to buy eye disease biotech Ollin for $3.4 bln, FT reports
items.summary: Investing.com-- Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) is in advanced talks to acquire privately held eye disease drug developer Ollin Biosciences for up to $3.4 billion, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
